answer:
According to the newest Ollama release notes covering LFM3 up to version 0.40.13, the LFM3 models run on Linux, Windows, and Apple silicon. This information is provided in the context of the release notes for version 0.40.13:

"**Liquid AI's [LFM3](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3) models, including text-to-speech in [lfm3-audio](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-audio) and [lfm3-omni](https://ollama.com/library/lfm3-omni), now run on Linux and Windows as well as Apple silicon.**" [ollama/v0.40.13.md](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.13) [lines 1-11]
